app-shell.tsx:AppShell.CommandDialog: Dialog composition: className styles its content; the root is a context provider. Compose Command and Dialog parts for custom elements.
app-shell.tsx:AppShell.TopNavMenu: Menu provider composition with separate trigger and content elements.
calendar.tsx:Calendar.Root: React Day Picker owns the calendar DOM; use its components API. Calendar.DayButton supports asChild.
command.tsx:Command.Dialog: Dialog provider composition; className targets the content, not a root DOM element.
data-table.tsx:DataTable.PageSize: Select provider composition with its own trigger and content; use Select parts for custom rendering.
data-table.tsx:DataTable.RowActions: Menu provider composition; its trigger prop supplies a custom trigger element.
data-table.tsx:DataTable.ViewOptions: Menu provider composition with separate trigger and content elements.
format.tsx:Format.Number: Ark returns formatted text, with no root DOM element.
format.tsx:Format.RelativeTime: Ark returns formatted text, with no root DOM element.
frame.tsx:Frame.Root: The iframe is required for the isolated document and content portals.
highlight.tsx:Highlight.Root: Ark renders multiple text and mark fragments; use useHighlight for a custom renderer.
hotkeys.tsx:Hotkeys.Dialog: Dialog provider composition with no root element.
input-otp.tsx:InputOTP.Root: input-otp owns its input and slot rendering; use the Ark PinInput parts for polymorphic inputs.
resizable.tsx:Resizable.Root: react-resizable-panels owns the group DOM; use the Ark Splitter parts for polymorphism.
resizable.tsx:Resizable.Handle: react-resizable-panels owns the separator element; Splitter.ResizeTrigger supports asChild.
resizable.tsx:Resizable.Panel: react-resizable-panels owns the panel element; Splitter.Panel supports asChild.
rich-text-editor.tsx:RichTextEditor.Cont: Tiptap owns the editable document DOM.
rich-text-editor.tsx:RichTextEditor.Bubb: Tiptap owns the floating menu DOM and its editor plugin registration.
sonner.tsx:Sonner.Root: Sonner owns the notification renderer; Ark Toast.Root supports polymorphism.
toast.tsx:Toast.Toaster: Ark's group renderer receives a per-toast render callback, not a replacement group child. Compose polymorphic Toast.Root elements inside it.
tree-view.tsx:TreeView.NodeCheckboxIndic: Ark selects among children, indeterminate, and fallback fragments without rendering an element.
